# CLI reference

Every command and option, generated deterministically from the binary's
own `--help` output. Regenerate with
`python3 tools/gen-cli-reference.py` after changing a help text.

Command-line interface for Brain for AI

```console
Usage: brain [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

```text
Commands:
  init         Create or migrate a local Brain database
  remember     Store an attributed, bi-temporal memory record
  ask          Search code, memory, and the private conversation archive
  recall       Search only records written through the memory command
  index        Index a source tree into the code graph
  when         Show when a topic was worked on
  timeline     Show what happened in a period
  explain      Explain why a decision was taken
  blockers     List what is currently in the way
  checkpoint   Summarise where the work stands
  goals        Show what the work is aiming at
  goal         State the goal outright, rather than leaving it to be inferred
  config       Show or change quality settings
  settings     Inspect settings history or restore only search profile/overrides
  status       Report database counts, salience layers, size, and freshness
  backup       Consistent snapshots of the brain with rotation and restore
  maintenance  One-off repairs over the stored database
  llm          Plug-in LLM providers (compute nodes)
  distill      Distill durable decisions and errors from archived sessions
  stats        What the brain holds per source (Graphify, Markdown folders, agent memory, conversation archive) and how fresh each source is
  query        Graphify: search the code/knowledge graph (runs `graphify query`)
  path         Graphify: shortest path between two graph nodes (runs `graphify path`)
  graph        Graphify graph commands that share a name with a Brain command
  doctor       Inspect integration and capture coverage without writing or starting services
  memory       List, inspect, forget, or export memory owned by this agent
  serve        Run the MCP server over newline-delimited stdio JSON-RPC [alias: mcp]
  archive      Read the private conversation archive, or switch and run its collector
  work         Coordinate work between agents and installations: tasks, claims, leases
  map          The work map: links, timeline and context packets built from local records
  team         Publish and query opt-in, typed facts for a team
  net          The coordinator over TLS: serve, enroll, revoke, call
  hook         Accept one agent hook event from JSON stdin and enqueue its safe metadata
  brief        Build the cached project context brief (at most 600 tokens)
  model        Manage explicitly approved local embedding models
  similar      Find past work resembling a task you are about to start
  template     Assemble a template from how similar work actually went
  ui           Open the settings window on a local-only web page
  reindex      Rebuild embeddings, optionally under a different model
  import       Refresh the imported part of the graph from a Graphify export
  clients      Explicitly registered agent-client homes (registration only: no client integration, discovery or capture)
  uninstall    Remove every agent integration recorded by `brain init --agents`
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --database <PATH>        SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version
```

### `brain init`

Create or migrate a local Brain database

```console
Usage: brain init [OPTIONS] [DATABASE]
```

```text
Arguments:
  [DATABASE]  Optional positional database path, kept for `brain init PATH`

Options:
      --agents                 Detect Claude, Codex, and Cursor user configs and connect Brain
      --database <PATH>        SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --dry-run                Show every proposed agent-config diff without writing anything
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --yes                    Apply non-conflicting agent-config changes without interactive prompts
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

### `brain remember`

Store an attributed, bi-temporal memory record

```console
Usage: brain remember [OPTIONS] <TEXT>
```

```text
Arguments:
  <TEXT>  Text to preserve

Options:
      --database <PATH>                SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --kind <KIND>                    Memory kind: fact, decision, task, gotcha, error, or note [default: fact]
      --space <SPACE>                  Memory namespace [default: default]
      --tag <TAGS>                     Retrieval tag; may be supplied more than once
      --agent <AGENT>                  Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --source <SOURCE>                Source path or URL
      --models-dir <DIR>               Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --source-weight <SOURCE_WEIGHT>  Source confidence/reliability in the range zero through one [default: 0.8]
      --share-state-dir <DIR>          Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --valid-from <VALID_FROM>        World-time validity start as Unix seconds (default: now)
      --offline                        Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --valid-to <VALID_TO>            Optional exclusive world-time validity end as Unix seconds
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

### `brain ask`

Search code, memory, and the private conversation archive

```console
Usage: brain ask [OPTIONS] <QUERY>
```

```text
Arguments:
  <QUERY>
          Natural-language query

Options:
      --budget-tokens <BUDGET_TOKENS>
          Hard upper bound for persisted conservative token estimates

      --database <PATH>
          SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)

      --no-archive
          Skip the private conversation archive for this call

      --space <SPACE>
          Memory namespace

          [default: default]

      --agent <AGENT>
          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership

          [default: brain-cli]

      --archive-role <ROLE>
          Restrict archive hits to this role; repeatable. One of user, assistant, tool_call, tool_result, tool_error, reasoning. Default: every role

      --models-dir <DIR>
          Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)

      --profile <PROFILE>
          Quality profile: fast, balanced, precise, or max

      --all-layers
          Include warm and cold salience layers in addition to hot

      --share-state-dir <DIR>
          Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it

      --offline
          Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download

          [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]

      --semantic
          Load the embedding model even when the words already answered.

          Only meaningful in the "on demand" mode, which otherwise skips the model — and the 2.5 seconds it costs — for a query the lexical search answered on its own.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

### `brain llm add`

Add a provider; the API key stays in an environment variable

```console
Usage: brain llm add [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

```text
Arguments:
  <NAME>  Provider name (referenced by llm test/remove)

Options:
      --base-url <BASE_URL>
          Base URL: https://… or http://127.0.0.1[:port]
      --database <PATH>
          SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --model <MODEL>
          Model name as the provider expects it
      --space <SPACE>
          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>
          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --command <COMMAND>
          Built-in subscription CLI adapter (no shell) [possible values: claude, codex]
      --effort <EFFORT>
          Reasoning effort for the adapter (low, medium or high; requires --command) [possible values: low, medium, high]
      --models-dir <DIR>
          Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --api-key-env <API_KEY_ENV>
          Environment variable NAME holding the API key (never the key)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>
          Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline
          Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --priority <PRIORITY>
          Fallback order: lower is tried first (default 100)
      --context-tokens <CONTEXT_TOKENS>
          Context window including output (HTTP default 16384; command default 128000)
      --timeout-seconds <TIMEOUT_SECONDS>
          Request timeout for this provider (10..=3600 seconds; default 120)
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

### `brain distill run`

Extract and persist facts from visible archive sessions

```console
Usage: brain distill run [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Options:
      --database <PATH>
          SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --session <SESSION>
          Distill only this archive session id
      --since <SINCE>
          Skip sessions whose latest entry is older than this ISO date or Unix timestamp
      --space <SPACE>
          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>
          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --provider <PROVIDER>
          Comma-separated provider names to use (default: all configured, priority order)
      --max-sessions <MAX_SESSIONS>
          Stop after this many sessions (1-1000, default 20) [default: 20]
      --models-dir <DIR>
          Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --batch-sessions <BATCH_SESSIONS>
          Maximum whole sessions per provider request (bounded by actual payload size) [default: 50]
      --share-state-dir <DIR>
          Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline
          Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --oldest-first
          Process sessions oldest first (default: newest first)
      --roles <ROLES>
          Comma-separated archive roles to include (default user,assistant,tool_error) [default: user,assistant,tool_error]
      --dry-run
          Count and plan without writing anything
      --keep-raw <KEEP_RAW>
          Save archive-derived provider responses locally for debugging (private files)
      --quiet-hours <QUIET_HOURS>
          Local HH-HH window in which no provider is invoked (requires --scheduled)
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

```text
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
```

```console
Usage: brain work handoff [OPTIONS] --to-agent <TO_AGENT> --to-machine <TO_MACHINE> <CLAIM> <FENCE>
```

```text
Arguments:
  <CLAIM>
  <FENCE>

Options:
      --database <PATH>          SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --to-agent <TO_AGENT>      Receiving agent name
      --space <SPACE>            Memory namespace [default: default]
      --to-machine <TO_MACHINE>  Receiving installation id (its machine-id)
      --agent <AGENT>            Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --ttl <TTL>                Lease length for the receiver in seconds (10-86400, default 900) [default: 900]
      --models-dir <DIR>         Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --note <NOTE>              Short reason recorded with the claim events [default: ""]
      --request-id <REQUEST_ID>  Idempotency key: retrying with the same id never duplicates
      --share-state-dir <DIR>    Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                  Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

### `brain map`

The work map: links, timeline and context packets built from local records

```console
Usage: brain map [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

```text
Commands:
  status              Read-only: is the work map configured and how much does it hold. Creates nothing
  init                Create the private map file at $BRAIN_HOME/map/map.sqlite (the only command that does)
  ingest-coordinator  Read the next batch of this installation's coordinator events of --space into the map
  timeline            Read-only timeline of --space, or of one task
  links               Read-only: one page of projected links of --space; pass `next_cursor` back as --cursor
  packet              Print the context packet itself: raw JSON, no trailing newline, its byte length within the budget
  help                Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --database <PATH>        SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

### `brain team`

Publish and query opt-in, typed facts for a team

```console
Usage: brain team [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

```text
Commands:
  invite     Local coordinator admin: issue one single-use role/project invitation (0600)
  accept     Register from an invitation; publication stays OFF without explicit consent
  who        Safe team roster: names, roles and observed freshness, no endpoints or secrets
  remove     Local coordinator admin: revoke a member and access to team slices
  peer       Coordinator admin: pin a source machine, origin, project, space and TLS endpoint
  ask        Search only complete verified replicas of explicitly selected machines
  manifest   Read-only local manifest: what, to whom and when. Missing policy means off
  peers      Read-only configured machine names, projects and last observed slice freshness
  configure  Host admin: bind project root, machine name, isolated space and recipients. Starts OFF
  enable     Enable this machine (or one class); a new publish is required before serving
  disable    Local opt-out overrides every remote grant immediately
  publish    Project allowed local sources and atomically publish a complete share generation
  schedule   Opt-in user timer for bounded publication
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --database <PATH>        SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

### `brain team invite`

Local coordinator admin: issue one single-use role/project invitation (0600)

```console
Usage: brain team invite [OPTIONS] --role <ROLE> --name <NAME>
```

```text
Options:
      --database <PATH>            SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>      Defaults to ~/.brain/net. Explicit --state-dir is recommended for isolated use
      --space <SPACE>              Memory namespace [default: default]
      --team-space <TEAM_SPACE>    Isolated team space, e.g. team.project.readers
      --agent <AGENT>              Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --role <ROLE>                Team role: worker publishes its slice; manager reads selected machines [possible values: worker, manager]
      --models-dir <DIR>           Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --name <NAME>                Unique machine name, 3..64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
      --project <PROJECT>          Project id, used as an explicit team.PROJECT shared-space boundary [default: default]
      --share-state-dir <DIR>      Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --expires <EXPIRES>          Invitation lifetime: seconds or suffix s, m, h, d (60s..90d) [default: 7d]
      --offline                    Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --out <OUT>                  New invitation file, 0600. Default: NAME.invite.json in current directory
      --dial <DIAL>                Coordinator address; default: this Brain home's running net serve
      --server-name <SERVER_NAME>  Coordinator certificate SAN; default: first name from net init
      --allow-lan-source           Permit this worker to register a private LAN source endpoint
      --allow-cgnat-source         Permit this worker to register a CGNAT source endpoint
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

### `brain team accept`

Register from an invitation; publication stays OFF without explicit consent

```console
Usage: brain team accept [OPTIONS] <FILE>
```

```text
Arguments:
  <FILE>

Options:
      --database <PATH>              SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>        Defaults to ~/.brain/net. Explicit --state-dir is recommended for isolated use
      --space <SPACE>                Memory namespace [default: default]
      --team-space <TEAM_SPACE>      Isolated team space, e.g. team.project.readers
      --agent <AGENT>                Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --publish                      Explicitly approve collection, enable the local slice and publish now
      --models-dir <DIR>             Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --root <ROOT>                  Worker project root (default: current directory); never sent to coordinator
      --share-state-dir <DIR>        Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --source-space <SOURCE_SPACE>  Local source space to project; no archive access is granted [default: default]
      --offline                      Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --source-dial <SOURCE_DIAL>    Worker's already running net serve endpoint; default: local runtime observation
      --allow-lan-dial               Explicitly allow dialing the coordinator on a private LAN address
      --allow-cgnat-dial             Explicitly allow dialing the coordinator on a CGNAT address
      --allow-lan-source             Approve publishing a private LAN source endpoint (also requires admin opt-in)
      --allow-cgnat-source           Approve publishing a CGNAT source endpoint (also requires admin opt-in)
  -h, --help                         Print help
```

### `brain team peer`

Coordinator admin: pin a source machine, origin, project, space and TLS endpoint

```console
Usage: brain team peer [OPTIONS] --machine <MACHINE> --origin <ORIGIN> --project <PROJECT>
```

```text
Options:
      --database <PATH>            SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>      Defaults to ~/.brain/net. Explicit --state-dir is recommended for isolated use
      --space <SPACE>              Memory namespace [default: default]
      --team-space <TEAM_SPACE>    Isolated team space, e.g. team.project.readers
      --agent <AGENT>              Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --machine <MACHINE>          Enrolled name of the source machine
      --models-dir <DIR>           Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --origin <ORIGIN>            Origin the source machine publishes under (pinned for verification)
      --project <PROJECT>          Project id expected in the machine's slice
      --share-state-dir <DIR>      Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                    Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --via-relay <HOST:PORT>      Explicit company relay (DNS:PORT or IP:PORT). Direct TCP is tried first when present
      --relay-token-file <FILE>    Separate relay credential (0600); register for serve, connect for clients/bundles
      --relay-name <NAME>          Exact name authorized by the relay token, [a-z0-9-]{3,64}
      --relay-ca <FILE>            Pinned CA for the relay's outer TLS (independent of coordinator CA)
      --relay-server-name <NAME>   Relay certificate SAN/SNI; default: host part of --via-relay
      --dial <IP:PORT>             Numeric dial target, e.g. 127.0.0.1:7443; default: endpoint.json from `net join`
      --allow-lan-dial             Opt in to dialing a private unicast LAN address (same policy as --allow-lan)
      --allow-cgnat-dial           Opt in to dialing a shared CGNAT/overlay address (same policy as --allow-cgnat)
      --server-name <NAME>         Name the server certificate must carry (SAN); default: endpoint.json
      --ca <FILE>                  The only CA trusted for this call (PEM); default: endpoint.json. System roots are never used
      --credential <FILE>          Credential file (0600, no symlink, owned by this uid); default: endpoint.json
      --credential-fd <N>          Inherited descriptor (>= 3) of a credential file; same checks as --credential
      --deadline-ms <DEADLINE_MS>  Absolute deadline for connect + handshake + request + response (50..=5000 ms) [default: 5000]
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

### `brain net`

The coordinator over TLS: serve, enroll, revoke, call

```console
Usage: brain net [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

```text
Commands:
  serve       Serve the coordinator over TLS (127.0.0.1 by default) until standard input closes
  relay       Company-hosted NAT relay with separate scoped tokens and end-to-end coordinator TLS
  enroll      Trusted local admin: create/refresh a principal and write a new credential file (0600)
  revoke      Trusted local admin: revoke one credential, or disable a machine and all its credentials
  principals  Trusted local admin: list principals (no secrets, no credential hashes)
  init        Create the coordinator's own CA and server certificate (rcgen, EC P-256)
  join        Unpack a join bundle: CA, credential and endpoint for this machine
  status      Ask the coordinator who this credential is and what it may call
  share       Opt-in shared memory: host-local enable/grant/publish and TLS pull
  call        Call one allowlisted coordinator tool over TLS
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --database <PATH>        SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

### `brain net serve`

Serve the coordinator over TLS (127.0.0.1 by default) until standard input closes.

Prints one JSON line with the actual bound address once it accepts. A private LAN address needs both --listen and the explicit --allow-lan.

```console
Usage: brain net serve [OPTIONS] --state-dir <DIR>
```

```text
Options:
      --database <PATH>
          SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)

      --via-relay <HOST:PORT>
          Explicit company relay (DNS:PORT or IP:PORT). Direct TCP is tried first when present

      --relay-token-file <FILE>
          Separate relay credential (0600); register for serve, connect for clients/bundles

      --space <SPACE>
          Memory namespace

          [default: default]

      --agent <AGENT>
          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership

          [default: brain-cli]

      --relay-name <NAME>
          Exact name authorized by the relay token, [a-z0-9-]{3,64}

      --models-dir <DIR>
          Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)

      --relay-ca <FILE>
          Pinned CA for the relay's outer TLS (independent of coordinator CA)

      --relay-server-name <NAME>
          Relay certificate SAN/SNI; default: host part of --via-relay

      --share-state-dir <DIR>
          Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it

      --offline
          Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download

          [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]

      --state-dir <DIR>
          Coordinator state directory (auth.sqlite, coord.sqlite). Required; no default

      --cert <FILE>
          Server certificate chain (PEM, owned by this uid); default DIR/tls/server.pem

      --key <FILE>
          Server private key (PEM, 0600, no symlink)

      --key-fd <N>
          Inherited descriptor (>= 3) holding the private key; same checks as --key

      --port <PORT>
          Port; 0 picks a free one (the JSON line says which)

          [default: 0]

      --listen <IP>
          Numeric listen IP (default 127.0.0.1). Hostnames are refused, never resolved

          [default: 127.0.0.1]

      --allow-lan
          Opt in to listening on a private unicast LAN address (RFC 1918 or fc00::/7). Wildcard, multicast, broadcast, link-local and public addresses are always refused

      --allow-cgnat
          Opt in to listening on a shared CGNAT/overlay address (RFC 6598 range, e.g. Tailscale IPv4)

      --deadline-ms <DEADLINE_MS>
          Absolute per-connection deadline in milliseconds (50..=5000)

          [default: 5000]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

### `brain net share`

Opt-in shared memory: host-local enable/grant/publish and TLS pull

```console
Usage: brain net share [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

```text
Commands:
  enable     Host-local: allow a space to be served and received. Default is off
  disable    Host-local: stop serving and receiving a space (already exported copies remain with peers)
  status     Host-local: origin id, enabled spaces, counts and memory grants (no payloads, no secrets)
  grant      Host-local: let one enrolled principal read one shared space (must be inside its namespace)
  ungrant    Host-local: withdraw a memory grant; effective on the next request
  publish    Host-local: publish ONE curated fact under this installation's origin
  retract    Host-local: retract one of this installation's live facts (peers see it when they pull)
  supersede  Host-local: replace one live fact's payload; history stays in the event stream
  facts      Host-local: list facts stored here (own and pulled), with provenance
  pull       Pull one peer's own shared events over TLS and apply them atomically
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --database <PATH>        SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

### `brain net share pull`

Pull one peer's own shared events over TLS and apply them atomically

```console
Usage: brain net share pull [OPTIONS] --state-dir <DIR> --space <SPACE> --peer-id <PEER_ID> --origin <ORIGIN>
```

```text
Options:
      --database <PATH>            SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --state-dir <DIR>            Local state directory whose share store receives the events
      --space <SPACE>              Space to pull events for
      --agent <AGENT>              Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --peer-id <PEER_ID>          Local label of the peer we pull from (trusted host context, recorded with each fact)
      --models-dir <DIR>           Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --origin <ORIGIN>            The origin id the peer must serve (from its `share status`); anything else is refused
      --share-state-dir <DIR>      Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --via-relay <HOST:PORT>      Explicit company relay (DNS:PORT or IP:PORT). Direct TCP is tried first when present
      --offline                    Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --relay-token-file <FILE>    Separate relay credential (0600); register for serve, connect for clients/bundles
      --relay-name <NAME>          Exact name authorized by the relay token, [a-z0-9-]{3,64}
      --relay-ca <FILE>            Pinned CA for the relay's outer TLS (independent of coordinator CA)
      --relay-server-name <NAME>   Relay certificate SAN/SNI; default: host part of --via-relay
      --dial <IP:PORT>             Numeric dial target, e.g. 127.0.0.1:7443; default: endpoint.json from `net join`
      --allow-lan-dial             Opt in to dialing a private unicast LAN address (same policy as --allow-lan)
      --allow-cgnat-dial           Opt in to dialing a shared CGNAT/overlay address (same policy as --allow-cgnat)
      --server-name <NAME>         Name the server certificate must carry (SAN); default: endpoint.json
      --ca <FILE>                  The only CA trusted for this call (PEM); default: endpoint.json. System roots are never used
      --credential <FILE>          Credential file (0600, no symlink, owned by this uid); default: endpoint.json
      --credential-fd <N>          Inherited descriptor (>= 3) of a credential file; same checks as --credential
      --deadline-ms <DEADLINE_MS>  Absolute deadline for connect + handshake + request + response (50..=5000 ms) [default: 5000]
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

### `brain net call`

Call one allowlisted coordinator tool over TLS

```console
Usage: brain net call [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

```text
Commands:
  whoami       The credential's identity as the coordinator sees it
  board        One page of tasks with their live owners
  show         One task
  claims       Live claims
  add          Add a queued task. Safe to retry with the same --request-id
  depend       TASK depends on ON. Not idempotent by id: query before retrying
  claim        Claim a task. Safe to retry with the same --request-id
  claim-path   Claim a path. Safe to retry with the same --request-id
  renew        Extend a lease. No request id: on an unknown outcome, query `verify` first
  release      Give a claim up. No request id: on an unknown outcome, query `verify` first
  state        Move a claimed task to paused/completed/failed/queued (finish). Safe to retry with the same --request-id
  handoff      Pass a live claim on. Safe to retry with the same --request-id
  share-pull   Read one page of the host's own shared events in --space (needs a host memory grant)
  share-query  Live facts the host itself published in --space (needs a host memory grant)
  verify       Exit 0 only if CLAIM/FENCE is still this credential's live claim
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --database <PATH>            SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --via-relay <HOST:PORT>      Explicit company relay (DNS:PORT or IP:PORT). Direct TCP is tried first when present
      --relay-token-file <FILE>    Separate relay credential (0600); register for serve, connect for clients/bundles
      --space <SPACE>              Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>              Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --relay-name <NAME>          Exact name authorized by the relay token, [a-z0-9-]{3,64}
      --models-dir <DIR>           Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --relay-ca <FILE>            Pinned CA for the relay's outer TLS (independent of coordinator CA)
      --relay-server-name <NAME>   Relay certificate SAN/SNI; default: host part of --via-relay
      --share-state-dir <DIR>      Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --dial <IP:PORT>             Numeric dial target, e.g. 127.0.0.1:7443; default: endpoint.json from `net join`
      --offline                    Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
      --allow-lan-dial             Opt in to dialing a private unicast LAN address (same policy as --allow-lan)
      --allow-cgnat-dial           Opt in to dialing a shared CGNAT/overlay address (same policy as --allow-cgnat)
      --server-name <NAME>         Name the server certificate must carry (SAN); default: endpoint.json
      --ca <FILE>                  The only CA trusted for this call (PEM); default: endpoint.json. System roots are never used
      --credential <FILE>          Credential file (0600, no symlink, owned by this uid); default: endpoint.json
      --credential-fd <N>          Inherited descriptor (>= 3) of a credential file; same checks as --credential
      --deadline-ms <DEADLINE_MS>  Absolute deadline for connect + handshake + request + response (50..=5000 ms) [default: 5000]
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

```text
      --limit <LIMIT>          Page size (1-10, default 10) [default: 10]
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)
      --share-state-dir <DIR>  Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it
      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
```

### `brain reindex`

Rebuild embeddings, optionally under a different model

```console
Usage: brain reindex [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Options:
      --database <PATH>
          SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)

      --model <ID>
          Rebuild under a different embedding model instead of the current one

      --force
          Recompute vectors that already exist instead of only filling gaps

      --space <SPACE>
          Memory namespace

          [default: default]

      --agent <AGENT>
          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership

          [default: brain-cli]

      --yes
          Approve a rebuild that destroys stored vectors or search cannot read

      --dry-run
          Report the plan and exit without writing anything

      --models-dir <DIR>
          Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)

      --paths
          Rebuild the two-hop graph paths instead of the vectors.

          Paths are maintained as edges arrive, so this is for a database whose edges came in by another route — an import from an older store, for instance, which leaves the graph walk with nothing to walk.

      --share-state-dir <DIR>
          Host-only: the `brain net` state directory whose shared facts map packets may read (absolute path). Unset, no shared fact is read; no MCP argument can set or change it

      --offline
          Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download

          [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

### `brain clients`

Explicitly registered agent-client homes (registration only: no client integration, discovery or capture)

```console
Usage: brain clients [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

```text
Commands:
  register     Register a client home explicitly (no integration or capture yet)
  list         List registrations (labels and checks; paths only with --show-paths)
  configure    Add (or with `unconfigure`, remove) the Brain MCP entry in the `config.toml` of a registered Codex home. Exactly one of `--dry-run` or `--yes` is required. Configured is not a handshake or capture
  unconfigure  Remove the Brain MCP entry added by `configure`, restoring the exact original bytes when the file was not edited since
  forget       Remove a registration. The client's directory is never touched
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --database <PATH>        SQLite database path (default: ~/.brain/brain.sqlite)
      --space <SPACE>          Memory namespace [default: default]
      --agent <AGENT>          Agent identity used for attribution and memory ownership [default: brain-cli]
      --models-dir <DIR>       Model cache directory (default: ~/.brain/models)

      --offline                Forbid even explicit model installation; ordinary commands never auto-download [env: BRAIN_OFFLINE=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```
